goal.text: Stay safe when it shakes at the mall.

intro.text: You are at the mall food court. The ground is shaking!

hint.text: Is there a strong table near you?

lesson.text: In the mall, Duck, Cover, and Hold. Stay away from glass and elevators.

choices.label: Run to the mall exit
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Do not run while it shakes. Take cover where you are.

choices.label: Ride the elevator down
choices.feedback: Never use the elevator in an earthquake. Take cover first.

choices.label: Stand by the glass shop window
choices.feedback: Glass can break and fall. Stay away from shop windows.

choices.label: Duck under the food court table
choices.feedback: Duck, Cover, and Hold. Stay until the shaking stops.
